```{r stops-setup}
sc <- readRDS(stop_check_path)
st_routes <- sc$routes
st_checks <- sc$checks
fmt <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
fmed <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; if (length(x)) median(x) else NA_real_ }
ratio_txt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x), "—", sprintf("%.2f", x))
dis <- st_routes[disagree == TRUE]
n_case <- uniqueN(dis$case_stop)
n_route <- nrow(unique(dis[, .(area, route)]))
ch <- st_checks[chosen == TRUE]
ch <- merge(ch, st_routes[, .(case_stop, route, stop_name, area, disagree)],
            by = c("case_stop", "route"))
ch <- ch[disagree == TRUE]
# one row per area, route and reading place: the case stops of a hub share it
chu <- ch[, .SD[1], by = .(area, route, document, read_at)]
# an Arriva timetable is six HTML pages (three day types, two directions)
n_docs <- uniqueN(sub("_(MF|Sa|Su)_(in|out)\\.html$", "",
                      unlist(strsplit(ch$document, "; "))))
n_rel <- nrow(unique(chu[reliable == TRUE, .(area, route)]))
n_force <- nrow(unique(chu[reliable == TRUE & edition_status == "in force", .(area, route)]))
```

## The stops where TNDS and BODS GTFS disagree most

*Built by the pipeline: `stop_pdf_check()` in `R/stop_pdf_validation.R` counts
the feeds, from the readings in `data/stop_pdf_documents.csv`, which
`scripts/stop_pdf_validation/read_docs.py` takes from the documents. When the
feeds, the conversion or the case list change, this section changes with
them.*

`stop_disagreement.md` ranks the stops where the two feeds disagree most and
draws the routes through each; it says what the feeds contain, not which is
right. This section asks the operators' timetables. It takes every route at
those `r n_case` case stops on which the feeds disagree, at the stop and its
neighbours within `r sc$radius_m` m, by at least `r sc$min_week` journeys a
week and `r round(100 * sc$min_share)`% of the larger: **`r n_route` routes**.
`r n_rel` of them have a reliable reading from `r n_docs` documents;
`r n_force` of those readings are from an edition **in force over the
window**.

**How a document is read.** Documents print timing points, and most case
stops are not one. Each reading names a place: the case stop, or the nearest
timing point every route through it prints (Hull Interchange, for two stops
1.3 km east of it), with a radius. A journey is counted once if it calls
anywhere there, in the document and in each feed alike, so the two sides
count the same thing. Readings carried over from the zone checks below were
taken over a whole zone, and for those the feeds are counted over the same
zone.

**Which edition.** Operators publish the current edition and few keep old
ones. The window is 27 July – 9 August 2026; it is now November.

* *In force*: the Go-Ahead group's archive (Brighton & Hove, Metrobus, East
  Yorkshire, Go North East) keeps every edition, and the one picked is the
  latest dated on or before the window with none starting inside it. Three
  NXWM summer editions (6, 50, 74) were collected in July.
* *Later edition*: First, National Express West Midlands, Stagecoach and
  Arriva serve only their current timetable. Arriva publishes no PDFs at all:
  its timetables are web pages, one operating date and direction at a time,
  saved whole as HTML (`scripts/stop_pdf_validation/arriva_dl.py`) and read
  the same way, row by row and journey by journey. First's API takes a date but no
  longer answers for an edition that has ended. These are 30 August to
  2 November editions. They cannot settle a difference of a few journeys,
  but they can settle a factor of two: timetables are not halved or doubled
  between editions, and where they were, the feeds of the later period show
  it.
* *Earlier edition*: the newest a site still offers, dated before the window.

**Window and day.** `stop_disagreement.md` found Chelmsford's TNDS stopping
part way through the window. A source that stops reads short over the window
and right on a day before it stops, so each check is made twice: per-day
means over the window, and the single day (Tuesday 28 July) against the
document's Monday–Friday column.

A source is **right** within `r round(100 * sc$tol)`% of the document,
*absent* when it carries nothing; "neither" names the nearer.

```{r stops-tally}
tally <- function(v) {
  t <- chu[reliable == TRUE, .N, by = .(v = fcoalesce(get(v), "no verdict (no weekday service in the document)"))][order(-N)]
  setNames(t, c("Verdict", "Routes"))
}
tw <- tally("verdict"); td <- tally("verdict_day")
tt <- merge(tw, td, by = "Verdict", all = TRUE, suffixes = c(" (window)", " (day)"))
tt[is.na(tt)] <- 0
setorder(tt, -`Routes (window)`)
knitr::kable(tt)
```

```{r stops-codes}
# Routes that disagree at the case stop but agree with the document at the
# reading place: the place is wider than the 100 m round the case stop, so
# the two feeds carry the same journeys and file them under different stops.
codes <- chu[reliable == TRUE & verdict == "both agree" & verdict_day == "both agree"]
codes_by <- codes[, .(n = .N, routes = paste(sort(unique(route)), collapse = ", ")), by = area]
codes_txt <- if (nrow(codes)) sprintf(paste0(
  "**%d routes are a stop-code difference, not a timetable one.** They ",
  "disagree at the case stop, yet both feeds match the document where it is ",
  "read, over the window and on the day: %s. The buses are the same; the ",
  "sources file them under different stop codes within a few hundred metres, ",
  "which is what stop_disagreement.md found for several of its one-source ",
  "stops. No timetable can say which code is right; NaPTAN can."),
  nrow(codes), paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", codes_by$area, codes_by$routes),
                     collapse = "; ")) else ""
```

`r codes_txt`

### Area by area

```{r stops-area}
area_sum <- chu[reliable == TRUE, .(
  Routes = .N,
  `In force` = sum(edition_status == "in force"),
  `TNDS ÷ doc, median` = sprintf("%.2f", fmed(tnds_ratio)),
  `BODS ÷ doc, median` = sprintf("%.2f", fmed(bods_ratio)),
  `TNDS ÷ doc, day` = sprintf("%.2f", fmed(tnds_day_ratio)),
  `BODS ÷ doc, day` = sprintf("%.2f", fmed(bods_day_ratio)),
  `TNDS right (window/day)` = sprintf("%d / %d", sum(grepl("^TNDS right|both", verdict)),
                                      sum(grepl("^TNDS right|both", verdict_day))),
  `BODS right (window/day)` = sprintf("%d / %d", sum(grepl("^BODS GTFS right|both", verdict)),
                                      sum(grepl("^BODS GTFS right|both", verdict_day)))),
  by = .(Area = area)]
setorder(area_sum, -Routes)
knitr::kable(area_sum, align = "lrrrrrrrr")
```

```{r stops-findings, results = "asis"}
# Generated from the table above by fixed rules, so it follows the data.
# Twice-the-timetable is the duplicate signature (bods_gtfs duplicates in
# near_duplicate_journeys.md); about half over the window but right on the day
# is the cut-off signature.
for (a in area_sum$Area) {
  x <- chu[reliable == TRUE & area == a]
  mt <- fmed(x$tnds_ratio); mb <- fmed(x$bods_ratio)
  dt <- fmed(x$tnds_day_ratio); db <- fmed(x$bods_day_ratio)
  say <- character(0)
  if (all(x$tnds_ratio == 0)) say <- c(say, "TNDS carries none of these routes here")
  if (all(x$bods_ratio == 0)) say <- c(say, "BODS GTFS carries none of these routes here")
  if (isTRUE(mb >= 1.4 && abs(mt - 1) <= 0.15))
    say <- c(say, sprintf("BODS GTFS runs %.1f times the timetable while TNDS matches it: extra journeys in BODS GTFS, the pattern of duplicated registrations", mb))
  if (isTRUE(mt <= 0.7 && abs(dt - 1) <= 0.2))
    say <- c(say, sprintf("TNDS reads %.2f of the timetable over the window but %.2f on the day: it stops part way through the window, not a different timetable", mt, dt))
  if (isTRUE(mb >= 1.4 && db >= 1.4 && !(abs(mt - 1) <= 0.15)))
    say <- c(say, sprintf("BODS GTFS is %.1f times the document on the day as well as over the window (%.1f)", db, mb))
  if (length(say) == 0)
    say <- sprintf("median TNDS %.2f and BODS GTFS %.2f of the documents over the window", mt, mb)
  ed <- if (all(x$edition_status == "in force")) "editions in force" else
    if (any(x$edition_status == "in force")) "some editions in force, the rest later" else
      "later editions only"
  cat(sprintf("* **%s** (%d routes, %s): %s.\n", a, nrow(x), ed,
              paste(say, collapse = "; ")))
}
```

```{r stops-figure, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5}
library(ggplot2)
pd <- rbind(chu[reliable == TRUE, .(area, route, edition_status, source = "TNDS", r = tnds_ratio)],
            chu[reliable == TRUE, .(area, route, edition_status, source = "BODS GTFS", r = bods_ratio)])
pd[, r := pmax(pmin(r, 4), 0.125)]
pd[, ed := ifelse(edition_status == "in force", "edition in force", "other edition")]
ggplot(pd, aes(r, reorder(area, r), colour = source, shape = ed)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1 - sc$tol, xmax = 1 + sc$tol, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.18, width = 0, seed = 1),
             size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4),
                labels = c("≤⅛", "¼", "½", "1", "2", "≥4")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(TNDS = "#1b6ca8", `BODS GTFS` = "#c2571a")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`edition in force` = 16, `other edition` = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Journeys in the feed ÷ journeys in the document (window, per day type)",
       y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL,
       title = "Each route through a case stop, against its timetable",
       subtitle = "Shaded: within the tolerance. A source carrying none of a route sits at the left edge.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Every reading

`Read at` is the document's own row label. Ratios are feed ÷ document: over
the window, from per-day means by day type; and on the single day, against
the Monday–Friday column. A route read at several case stops of one place is
shown once.

```{r stops-table}
tab <- chu[order(area, route), .(
  Area = area, Route = route,
  Document = sub("; .*", " …", document),
  Edition = paste(edition_from, sprintf("(%s)", edition_status)),
  `Read at` = substr(sub(";.*", "", read_at), 1, 32),
  `Doc MF/Sa/Su` = sprintf("%s/%s/%s", fmt(doc_MF), fmt(doc_Sa), fmt(doc_Su)),
  `TNDS MF` = fmt(at_tnds_MF, 1), `BODS MF` = fmt(at_bods_gtfs_MF, 1),
  `T÷doc` = ratio_txt(tnds_ratio), `B÷doc` = ratio_txt(bods_ratio),
  `T÷doc day` = ratio_txt(tnds_day_ratio), `B÷doc day` = ratio_txt(bods_day_ratio),
  Verdict = ifelse(reliable, verdict, "reading unreliable"),
  `Verdict, day` = ifelse(reliable, verdict_day, "—"))]
knitr::kable(tab)
```

### Routes still needing a document

Every disagreeing route at a case stop without a reliable reading, and every
one whose only reading is from an edition not in force. The bustimes.org link
is the case stop's page, which lists the services there and links each to
its operator. bustimes.org is not itself a referee: it is built from the same
operator TransXChange as BODS and shows only current and future timetables.

```{r stops-missing}
have <- unique(ch[reliable == TRUE, .(case_stop, route, edition_status)])
need <- merge(dis[, .(case_stop, stop_name, area, route, operators,
                      tnds_MF, bods_gtfs_MF)],
              have, by = c("case_stop", "route"), all.x = TRUE)
need[, why := fcase(is.na(edition_status), "no reliable reading",
                    edition_status != "in force", "only a later or earlier edition",
                    default = NA_character_)]
need <- need[!is.na(why)]
nd <- need[, .(`Case stops` = paste(unique(sprintf("[%s](https://bustimes.org/stops/%s)",
                                                   stop_name, case_stop)), collapse = ", "),
               Operator = paste(unique(unlist(strsplit(operators, " / "))), collapse = " / "),
               `TNDS MF` = fmt(max(tnds_MF), 1), `BODS MF` = fmt(max(bods_gtfs_MF), 1),
               Needed = why[1]),
           by = .(Area = area, Route = route)]
nd[, Needed := factor(Needed, c("no reliable reading",
                                "only a later or earlier edition"))]
setorder(nd, Needed, Area, Route)
cat_n <- nd[, .N, by = Needed]
```

`r paste(sprintf("%d %s", cat_n$N, cat_n$Needed), collapse = "; ")`.

```{r stops-missing-table}
knitr::kable(nd)
```
